blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Anmore. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Anmore, Port Moody: 26 houses listed at the end of October 2026 and 3 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 12%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. By listings that is number 1 of 11 Port Moody communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Port Moody total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Anmore was little changed, 26 in June and 26 in October (+0.0%), and 6 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 18.8% of Port Moody’s 138 houses listed.

blocks.text: Anmore home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

11 houses sold in Anmore with a median price of $2,725,000 (the middle half sold between $1,801,000 and $3,387,500), taking a median of 28 days to sell at 94.0% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $542 per square foot, a median year built of 2008 and a median lot of 43,560 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Anmore?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 26 houses listed in Anmore. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Anmore a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Anmore had a sales ratio of 12%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Anmore from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 6 houses sold in Anmore over those 5 months, out of 64 in all of Port Moody.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Anmore?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Anmore sell for?
faq.a: 11 houses sold in Anmore between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $2,725,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Anmore?
faq.a: The median was 28 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 94.0% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
